summary: The week was dominated by one stalled workstream: getting Lauryn's Facebook page out of 'not recommended' status. Vivek (Meta rep) spent six days going in circles - he asked her to hand over her Gmail login, she refused on security grounds, he asked her to reset the FB password (she did, and pasted the new password straight into the chat), he missed two self-imposed update deadlines ('Will update you in 2 hours', 'Will be share update with you in a hour'), and on Aug 13 he asked for her Gmail login a second time after she had already declined twice. Lauryn ended up appealing to Facebook herself on Aug 12-13 and got the page restored on her own - but it is still flagged 'NOT RECOMMENDABLE'. Derrek stepped in on Aug 13, explained the mechanics clearly and delivered a proper step-by-step guide that respects her security stance. On payments, last week's blocked Zelle was answered on Aug 9 (ALTR's Zelle 'having issues again'; she was redirected to Derrek's personal Zelle number) and she paid in two tranches - but $1,852.15 of the Aug 1 invoice is still unpaid at week close and is being rolled into the next invoice. Tone stayed warm throughout; the risk is entirely ALTR-side execution.

health.rationale: Down from 58. Her single longest-running complaint (FB 'not recommended', open since Sept 2025) went a full week with no ALTR progress - she had to appeal it herself. Vivek missed two self-set update deadlines, forced her to chase 5 times, and re-asked for the Gmail credentials she had already refused twice, which is exactly the trust line she has drawn. Payment is again partially unpaid and rolling forward, and ALTR's Zelle failed again. Offsetting this: she is paying, her tone is still warm ('Great morninggg'), and Derrek's Aug 13 recovery was strong.
